title: Settiez & HUD content
summary: Pickz what da HUD shows and how it looks.

blocks.title: Create, keepz, deletz and peekz
blocks.body: Start from a built-in setty and Keepz to create a custom copiez, or create a new setty. Deletz removes custom settiez while original presets remain. Peekz uses da current edit and real infoz; Keepz commits it to da running HUD.

blocks.title: Text regions and icons
blocks.body: Tagline, title, primary/secondary text and da right-side value can mix literal text and changey thing tokens. Use da right suffix for units such as %, °C or GHz. Icons identify da content; da accent color sets da capsule and ring color.

blocks.title: Ring changey thing and range
blocks.body: Da ring maps (value − minimum) over da configured range, clamped to 0–100%. Use a changey thing key or a numeric expression beginning wif =. Set a sensible full-scale value for temperature, traffic or FPS. Da range does not change da raw text reading.

blocks.title: Conditional colors
blocks.body: Add one changey thing/operator/threshold => color rule per line. Rules change da accent based on load, temperature and other values. Thresholds use da changey thing's original unit. Use valid color values; missing measurements r not treated as zero.

title: Changey thingz, tokens & expressions
summary: Copiez from da library, then build readable HUD text.

blocks.title: Find and copiez a changey thing
blocks.body: Findz by name, key or category under Infoz Management → Changey thing Library. Select a changey thing to see its meaning, type, unit and formats. Copiez Changey thing Key iz useful for rings and rules; Copiez Template includes braces for text fields.

blocks.title: Common token formats
blocks.body: Place da key in braces, followed by | and a display format. Use 0 for integers and 0.0 / 0.00 for fixed decimals. Literal text may surround tokens. Formatting changes display only.

blocks.title: Automatic units and pipelines
blocks.body: auto:1 chooses units based on da changey thing; avoid adding da same unit twice. Format pipelines run left to right and can transform numbers or shorten text. Use {= ...} for inline expressions, or start a ring expression wif =.

blocks.title: Operators and conditions
blocks.body: Use +, -, *, /, % remainder, ^ power and parentheses. Comparisons support >, >=, <, <=, == and !=. Boolean operators include &&, ||, ! and and/or/not. Conditions use test ? yes : no or if(test, yes, no). ?? supplies a fallback for null/empty values.

blocks.title: Numeric function reference
blocks.body: Aggregates: min, max, avg and sum. Range/precision: clamp(value, min, max), round(value, digits), floor, ceil, abs and sign. Math: sqrt, pow, log, log10, exp, sin, cos and tan. percent(value, total) returns a percentage; between(value, min, max) tests an inclusive range.

blocks.title: Text, types and pipeline reference
blocks.body: Expression functions: len, contains, startswith, endswith, upper, lower and concat. Convert types wif number, string or bool; inspect them wif isnull, isempty and isnan. Token pipelines support upper/lower, zero-based sub:start:length, replace:old:new and math:add/sub/mul/div/round/floor/ceil/abs.

blocks.title: Capacity and time formats
blocks.body: bytes / speed add automatic byte-bigness or byte-rate units. kb:n, mb:n, gb:n and tb:n divide by powers of 1024 wif n decimals; add da desired unit in da setty. duration / duration-long format seconds. Date/time fields support time:<date format>; time:relative formats relative time or duration.

blocks.title: Computery bitz changey thingz and legacy keys
blocks.body: Once equivalent computery bitz fields r discovered, duplicate legacy entries leave da library while existing settiez keep working. New keys identify a specific device and sensor. Highest/average summaries have different meanings and remain separate. -- means no valid value iz currently available.

blocks.title: DeepSeek balance and peak periods
blocks.body: Enter a DeepSeek API key under Infoz Management → Infoz Source Configuration, then Keepz & Do eet. Keys r encrypted for da current Android user and may need re-entry for another account or machine. Peak peek-holez use Beijing time and da Chinese holiday calendar; weekend make-up workdays remain off-peak.

blocks.title: Configure HTTP / JSON
blocks.body:
Enter an HTTP/HTTPS GET URL dat returns JSON and name da source.
Map response paths such as data.value or players[0].name to changey thing names.
Set required headers and lookz again seconds, turnz on da source, then Keepz & Do eet.
Find custom.<source>.<variable> in da library and use it in a setty.

blocks.title: Copyable JSON structure
blocks.body: Dis structure iz iz off. Replace da URL wif ur real endpoint, adjust paths to da response and set iz on to true when ready. ${env:MY_API_KEY} reads a process environment changey thing instead of putting a secret directly in JSON.

blocks.title: Status, cache and errors
blocks.body: Use custom.<source>.status / oopsie for source state and failures. Da lookz again interval controls caching, even wif faster all da sampling. For 401/403, check authentication and access. JSON paths must match da actual response structure.

blocks.title: Build a carousel queue
blocks.body: Add settiez to da queue and use Move Up/Down to order them. Removing from da queue does not deletz da setty. Automatic cycling advances at da configured interval. An empty queue uses da active setty; a single-item queue cannot switch to a different item.

blocks.title: Three cycle animations
blocks.body: Simple shortens da presentation; Full uses da complete summon. Roll Up moves icons, values and da ring inside a persistent capsule while retaining its peek-hole and layer. Roll applies to persistent switches; initial and transient presentations keep their normal show/retract lifecycle. DeepSeek peak transitions keep Full animation.

blocks.title: Click a persistent HUD to switch
blocks.body: Turnz on click cycling to advance through da queue even wif automatic cycling off. Each HUD advances its own instance and resets its cycle timer. Transparent areas remain click-through. Empty or single-item queues do not switch.
